subject.title: fix(heartbeat): stop reporting success after tool failures

question: Should `toolMutationRuntime`, `toolExecutionRuntime`, and the `agent-tool-failure` heartbeat reason become the approved generic host/plugin-harness contract for this invariant?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but these additive SDK and terminal-result surfaces become durable contracts whose ownership cannot be decided from tests alone.

options.title: Approve the generic host contract
options.body: Accept the two optional harness runtime fields and new failure reason as the canonical cross-runtime boundary, then land the proven patch.

options.title: Keep the public SDK unchanged
options.body: Require a narrower owner-approved mechanism that preserves the same standard/Codex behavior without exposing new harness attempt fields.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic host contract
recommendation.body: Accept the two optional harness runtime fields and new failure reason as the canonical cross-runtime boundary, then land the proven patch.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged structured-heartbeat and Codex-response work introduced the central contract this PR extends.
